trigger: HeatingStructure.load dispatches compound inventory to MeltingModuleInventory.readFromTag
input: optional non-strict size unsigned byte, item list with typed byte slot
output: non-strict array resized; existing module stacks cleared; valid typed unsigned slot restores module
preservation: Owner wrapper typechecks compound before dispatch and restores structure/capability separately; inventory reset prevents stale old stacks surviving replacement.
application_limit: Missing size in non-strict mode yields0 and can truncate everything; only valid slots restored. Borrow type/presence validation before resizing owned data, never erase target progress due absent source field.

trigger: ScaledFluidTank.readFromNBT for stack-count-scaled item fluid tank
input: serialized per-single-item FluidStack amount plus instance scale
output: loaded amount multiplied by scale, then setFluid enforces exact scale multiples
preservation: Full class read: paired writer copies fluid and divides amount by scale. Fill/drain enforce same scale; actual inventory stack amount and per-item resource unit differ.
application_limit: Overflow/scale0 malformed state not guarded here; factory scale1 uses ordinary tank. Borrow preserve numeric units and representation, not blindly copy counters between formats.

input: typed stack compound, water inertia, dealtDamage and typed task list
output: stack restored only for compound; tasks decode only for list; damage/motion state restored
preservation: Item payload retains modular components through native ItemStack.of rather than regenerating base arrow; scheduled payload separate from runtime motion.
application_limit: No explicit reset on absent optional stack/tasks; downstream unknown modifier IDs unverified. Borrow exact payload preservation but exclude active counterattack/scheduled combat state from new Dynasty root whitelist.

input: item compound or fluid compound discriminated by key presence
output: item first then fluid; neither returns shared EMPTY
preservation: Same output abstraction preserves payload kind; both keys present favors item, so fallback precedence is observable and not arbitrary.
application_limit: contains not typed; bad item payload does not then fall through to valid fluid. Borrow validate old target and payload type before selecting compatibility fallback.

input: typed BURN_TIME/BURN_DURATION ints plus superclass energy/inventory
output: restores burn values only correct type; recomputes NO_POWER/FULL_POWER/EMPTY_INPUT from energy, capacitor and actual fuel
preservation: Persisted processing progress distinct from derived status flags; current fuel payload determines EMPTY_INPUT.
application_limit: No independent inventory decoder credit here; NO_POWER explicitly false on load may not mean final powered truth. Borrow reconcile derived rank/notifications after preserving actual merit, not copying every derived root flag.

input: saved inventory and optional legacy IO_CONFIG/REDSTONE_CONTROL attachments or newer direct tag fields, owner UUID
output: legacy attachment takes precedence, transfers field then removes old attachment; otherwise direct field codec; inventory parsed by bounded MachineInventory helper
preservation: MachineInventory support exact body restores only valid slots and successful ItemStack.parse, logs invalid indexes. Ownership migration removes old store after transferring value, not creating new item/reward.
application_limit: Source attachment values assigned by reference; no promise deep copy. Bad owner UUID/codec errors may abort. Borrow avoid two competing owners, but Dynasty already-owned PlayerPersisted must be untouched.

input: optional owner UUID, security codec, follow/pickup defaults, home, inventory/energy containers, progress and skin
output: binds decoded owner, defaults invalid security PUBLIC, home null, item and energy containers restored before progress
preservation: Real personal robot state ties owner/security to item payload and stored energy; invalid security fallback can weaken access and is explicitly a risk.
application_limit: No claim nested ContainerType readers lossless; skin is cosmetic and no separate credit. Borrow preserve owner/progress only with known role, not assume generic default safe.

input: two world inventory lists; optional Curios lists when mod installed and vethea_curios key present
output: world inventories restored always; Curios lists only loaded under compatibility guard
preservation: Full writer/consumer read: writes Curios only installed; consumer clears actual player inventory then loads selected saved list and broadcasts changes. transferTo assigns list references shallowly.
application_limit: String inv comparison uses ==, not value equality; absent optional Curios leaves existing fields. Generic Clone wrapper must be merged, not second credit. Borrow source-driven optional-mod compatibility and detached tag ownership.

input: modern full item inventory or loot table; old item compound for non-Oxcrate
output: allocates fresh slots, loads modern payload unless loot table, then legacy item overwrites slot0 and old key removed
preservation: Explicit subtype exclusion prevents applying one-slot legacy schema to Oxcrate; migration runs after modern loader and has defined precedence.
application_limit: Old item presence not typed and parsing may become EMPTY; modern slot0 overwritten even when valid. Borrow exact legacy schema guard and do not discard old payload before validated conversion.

input: full inventory, BurnTime/CookTime/CookTimeTotal and RecipesUsed map
output: fresh list loaded; progress restored; litDuration recomputed from saved fuel; recipe-use counts keyed by parsed ResourceLocation
preservation: Recipe reward accounting restored together with cooking continuation; remaining burn timer and total duration have distinct sources.
application_limit: Invalid recipe ID can throw; recipesUsed map not cleared. InfiniFurnace similar reader recorded duplicate; no credit for merely removing fuel fields.

input: slot-coded inv list and caps compound codec
output: restores inventory via ItemStackWithSlot codec and capability snapshot or new empty compound
preservation: Minion inventory and its own entity capability snapshot are separate stored roles; subclass contract requires super invocation.
application_limit: This object owns caps snapshot; cannot generalize its compound copy into copying player root ForgeData. No claim all nested caps are permanent or survive death.

input: saved items, run time and running ritual player UUID
output: restores inventory/run time; only running state reads UUID; loadRitual failure sets abortPendingFromLoad
preservation: Unavailable original player is handled as pending abortion instead of silently binding another owner or running ritual reward.
application_limit: Missing/invalid UUID produces no callback and visible body does not set abortPending; nested ritual failure branches not all traced. Borrow safe unknown-owner handling; do not migrate old quest counters by fabricated current FTB identity.

input: input/output fluid child payloads, filter item and cooldown counters
output: restores both fluid roles; filter OPTIONAL_CODEC or EMPTY; cooldowns default-1
preservation: Actual filtering machine has two separate fluid owners, unlike grinder input item/filter roles; -1 sentinel explicitly differs from zero elapsed time.
application_limit: Child absence still invokes deserialize on empty input; downstream reset semantics unverified. Borrow preserve meaningful sentinels and keep each long-cooldown owner’s own death policy.

output: initializes owned inventory then loads slots, elapsed and total cooking ticks each default0
preservation: Both elapsed and target duration restored so progress ratio remains defined by source values; actual state mutation qualifies as persistent reader, not accessor.
application_limit: No validation elapsed<=total or total>0; no death permanence inferred. Borrow audit counters using source consumer, not all integer fields as earned player progress.

input: required ItemStack codec under item plus blood_stored and charging_ticks ints
output: invalid/missing item becomes EMPTY; resource and charging counters default0 independently
preservation: Stored resource ownership and item payload restored in same pedestal; does not regenerate consumed blood from item or reward it during load.
application_limit: No visible clearing charge when item fails parse; orphaned progress possible. Borrow compatible field coupling and preserve original typed permanent values without invoking gameplay consumers.

reason: ThrownShuriken reader repeats ModifiableArrow carried-stack/inertia/tasks control flow with dealtDamage statement removed; not extra credit for near clone.
LegacyMachineBlockEntity delegates owned inventory and rendering refresh around super load; same actual machine inventory chain, no separate payload implementation.
